name: manual_07da0c
claim: Reproduce every review finding before fixing it and expect the reproduction to show it is real for a different reason than stated.

decisions.notes: Rolling back a committed reservation raises UnknownReservationError, which made a double-release finding real; a NUL byte in an argv raises ValueError only after the one-attempt marker is claimed. Fixing from the comment alone would have missed both.
